description: Flat metadata schema for individual reagents used in fluorescent staining of cultured cell line imaging experiments, including fluorescent dyes and secondary antibodies.

reagent_name.descr: Common name or product name of the reagent used in the staining protocol, e.g., 'Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-mouse IgG' or 'DAPI'.

reagent_class.descr: High-level reagent category, e.g., fluorescent dye, secondary antibody, counterstain, blocking reagent, or other staining reagent.

reagent_role.descr: Functional role in the experiment, e.g., nuclear stain, membrane stain, cytoplasmic stain, secondary detection reagent, or control reagent.

target_analyte.descr: Target recognized or labeled by the reagent, e.g., mouse IgG, actin, tubulin, nucleus, DNA, or 'not applicable' for non-targeted dyes.

host_species.descr: Species in which an antibody reagent was raised, e.g., goat, rabbit, mouse; use 'not applicable' for non-antibody dyes.

target_species.descr: Species targeted by an antibody reagent, e.g., mouse, rabbit, human; use 'not applicable' when irrelevant.

clone_id.descr: Antibody clone identifier when applicable, e.g., 'polyclonal', '4G10', or a specific clone designation; use 'not applicable' for dyes.

fluorophore_name.descr: Fluorescent label attached to or intrinsic to the reagent, e.g., FITC, Alexa Fluor 488, Cy3, DAPI.

excitation_wavelength_nm.descr: Primary excitation wavelength in nanometers (nm), if known, e.g., 488, 561, 405.

emission_wavelength_nm.descr: Primary emission wavelength in nanometers (nm), if known, e.g., 520, 570, 461.

vendor_name.descr: Manufacturer or supplier name, e.g., Thermo Fisher Scientific, Abcam, Cell Signaling Technology.

catalog_number.descr: Vendor catalog or product number used to identify the exact reagent.

lot_number.descr: Manufacturer lot or batch number for traceability.

batch_number.descr: Internal or external batch identifier if different from lot number; use 'not available' if not provided.

supplier_country.descr: Country of the supplier or manufacturer, if relevant for provenance tracking.

concentration_value.descr: Concentration of the reagent stock or working solution as a numeric value.

concentration_unit.descr: Unit for concentration_value, e.g., 'ug/mL', 'mM', 'nM', 'mg/mL', or '1:500' if recorded as a ratio.

working_dilution.descr: Working dilution used in the experiment, typically expressed as a ratio such as 1:200; store as numeric dilution factor if needed by local convention.

stock_concentration_value.descr: Stock concentration before dilution, as a numeric value when available.

incubation_time_min.descr: Incubation time with the reagent in minutes.

incubation_condition.descr: Free-text summary of incubation conditions, e.g., '30 min at room temperature', 'overnight at 4 C'.

application_order.descr: Order of application within the staining workflow, where smaller values indicate earlier steps.

wash_steps_count.descr: Number of wash steps performed after using the reagent.

fixation_required.descr: Whether the reagent was used on fixed cells (true) or live cells (false).

permeabilization_required.descr: Whether cell permeabilization was required for reagent access.

secondary_antibody_flag.descr: True if the reagent is a secondary antibody; false otherwise.

conjugated_flag.descr: True if the reagent is chemically conjugated to a fluorophore or other reporter.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the reagent before use.

storage_buffer.descr: Buffer or solvent used for reagent storage, e.g., PBS, glycerol-based buffer, BSA solution, DMSO.

preparation_notes.descr: Free-text notes on preparation, aliquoting, reconstitution, filtering, or handling steps relevant to reproducibility.

expiration_date.descr: Expiration date of the reagent, if known.

qa_qc_status.descr: Quality control status of the reagent before use, e.g., passed, failed, not assessed.

signal_expected_localization.descr: Expected cellular localization pattern of the signal, e.g., nucleus, membrane, cytosol, punctate, or extracellular.

controls_used.descr: Description of controls associated with this reagent, e.g., isotype control, no-primary control, unstained control.
